questions.prompt: In fact, a visit to a major European city just would not be the same 16 encountering them: bathing in fountains, perching on historic buildings, and flocking in public squares.
questions.explanation: without 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 encountering；would not be the same without… 意為「少了…就不一樣了」。as、though 當連接詞時後面接的是子句（正式書面語裡 though 可以接 V-ing，但這裡語意接不上），for + V-ing 用於說明物品用途，都不合。

questions.prompt: In Barcelona, however, the birds are now threatening to 17 the city's historic center, pooping on monuments, buildings, and even tourists.
questions.explanation: take over 是「接管、占據」，本句指鴿子正威脅著要占據巴塞隆納的歷史城區；set up（設立）、hang on（稍等、堅持）、break down（故障、破裂）語意都不合。

questions.prompt: The city council originally proposed 18 the pigeon population by gathering the birds and shooting them.
questions.explanation: 語意「市議會原本提議透過聚集並射殺鴿子來『減少』鴿子數量」，reducing（減少）符合，跟後文槍殺鴿子的手段呼應；counting（計算）、displaying（展示）、maintaining（維持，語意相反）都不合。

questions.prompt: After heated debates and discussions, the government was finally persuaded to consider another 19 effective method: giving the pigeons birth control.
questions.explanation: 語意「另一個『同樣』有效的方法」，similarly（同樣地）符合，暗示這個新方法跟原本的方法一樣有效（但更人道）；nearly（幾乎）、shortly（不久）、precisely（精確地）都不合。

questions.prompt: Starting from April 2017, the pills were placed in 40 bird feeders 20 throughout the city.
questions.explanation: 過去分詞 installed 作後位形容詞修飾 feeders，表示「安裝在城市各處的鳥類餵食器」；installing（現在分詞，主動語意方向不合，應該是餵食器「被安裝」）、to install（不定詞）、having installed（完成分詞，不合這個被動語境）都不合。

questions.prompt: The concept was 11 by Richard Booth, who opened the first second-hand bookshop in Hay-on-Wye, UK in 1961.
questions.explanation: 語意「這個概念是由理查布斯『發起』的」，initiated（發起）符合，呼應後文他開了第一家二手書店；represented（代表）、acknowledged（承認）、manipulated（操縱）都不合。

questions.prompt: Since the 1970s, book towns like Hay on-Wye 12 up all over the world.
questions.explanation: 現在完成進行式 have been springing，配合 Since the 1970s（自從 1970 年代起，持續到現在），spring up 表示「湧現/興起」；spring（現在式，不符合持續性）、sprang（過去式）、had sprung（過去完成式，沒有更早的過去參照點）都不合。

questions.prompt: Although all book towns have a great number of bookshops, that's where the similarities 13 .
questions.explanation: that's where the similarities end 是固定說法，意為「相似之處就到此為止」，呼應下一句各書鎮各有特色；form（形成）方向相反，count（計算、重要）、matter（重要）都無法與 that's where 構成這個說法。

questions.prompt: Clunes, in Australia, holds a monthly book talk that hosts authors to discuss their latest 14 .
questions.explanation: 語意「邀請作家討論他們最新的『發行作品』」，releases（發行作品，指新書）符合這個書籍主題語境；trends（趨勢）、agendas（議程）、announcements（公告）都不合。

questions.prompt: As digital reading is changing our traditional way of reading, book towns like Hay-on-Wye are particularly important to 15 .
questions.explanation: 語意「像海伊鎮這樣的書鎮對『讓紙本文字保持存續』特別重要」，keep the printed word alive 符合，呼應後文強調保存實體書的重要性；get their worldwide fame（獲得世界性名聲）、conform to the new mode（順應新模式，語意方向不合）、make their visitors satisfied（讓訪客滿意）都不合。

questions.prompt: It looks like a precisely engineered jigsaw puzzle, each branch growing just perfectly so it almost, 11 , touches the neighboring tree.
questions.explanation: almost, but not quite, touches 意為「幾乎碰到、但就是差那麼一點」，正是樹冠羞避現象的關鍵；in no time（立刻）、by all means（當然可以）、and pretty much（差不多）語意都不合。

questions.prompt: Scientists have been discussing crown shyness since the 1920s, proposing 12 explanations for the phenomenon.
questions.explanation: 語意「提出『多種』解釋」，multiple（多種的）符合，呼應後文列舉兩派學者不同的解釋（保護樹枝說、資源競爭說）；universal（普遍的）、productive（多產的）、conventional（傳統的）都不合。

questions.prompt: Other scientists suggest that plants, like animals, 13 resources—nutrients, water, space, and light.
questions.explanation: 【句型】compete for 指「競爭……」，表示植物像動物一樣「競爭」資源；get over（克服）、give way to（讓位給）、make up for（彌補）都不合。

questions.prompt: Gaps in the treetops resulting from crown shyness may allow trees to increase their 14 light and enhance photosynthesis.
questions.explanation: 【句型】exposure to 指「暴露於/接觸到」，表示樹冠間的縫隙讓樹木能增加「接觸」陽光的機會；reliance on（依賴）、sensitivity to（對……敏感）、reflection on（對……的反思）都不合。

questions.prompt: Additionally, by having branches that do not touch those of their neighbors, trees may be able to limit the spread of leaf-eating insects, and potentially also the transmission of diseases from tree to tree. 15 decades of investigation, there is no consensus on exactly what causes the beautiful and mysterious phenomenon of crown shyness.
questions.explanation: 語意「儘管經過數十年的研究，仍然沒有共識」，Despite（儘管）符合這種讓步轉折；For（因為）、Besides（此外）、Concerning（關於）都不合。
